description: Voice I/O pipeline — TTS generation and ASR comprehension. TerranSoul-only (no OpenJarvis equivalent).

prompts.input: Say good morning to me in a cheerful way.
prompts.context_seed: Companion persona is energetic and uses short sentences suitable for TTS. User prefers Japanese-style greetings.

prompts.input: [ASR input] 'Can you remind me about my meeting at three?'
prompts.context_seed: User has a calendar memory entry: 'Team standup at 3 PM in the main conference room'.

prompts.input: Read me the summary of what I worked on today, keep it short for audio.
prompts.context_seed: User worked on: fixed 3 bugs in auth module, reviewed 2 PRs, started new feature branch for payments.

scoring_rubric.relevance: Is the response appropriate for spoken delivery?
scoring_rubric.accuracy: Are facts from memory correctly recalled?
scoring_rubric.completeness: Is the response concise enough for TTS without losing key info?
